verdict.rationale: Box ships a built-in AI, Box AI, that can ask questions about, summarize, extract metadata from, and generate content for files in Box (box-docs-9, box-docs-26). It also answers questions over curated Box Hubs (box-docs-13) and can run automated extraction when files land in a folder (box-docs-12). Its AI agents are configurable with selectable models (box-docs-18, box-docs-42), and box.com markets co-creating content with AI inside the product (box-docs-15). missing for 10: documentation of the in-app assistant UI rather than the API surface, evidence of delegating multi-step actions beyond summarize/extract/generate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
